lines: Oops! My berries are making a break for it!
I was saving those for my second breakfast!
Fresh candy canes! No watering required!
You have got me in mint condition!
I am not wobbly. I am extra jolly!
Careful, dear. My pockets are full of peanuts!
A little nutty? Why, thank you!
My dance moves are pop approved!
Stay cool, my sweet little snowflake.
A royal wiggle? How ice of you!
My crown is straight. My jokes are crooked!
My bats! They always leave before the punch line!
Oops. Was that your shoe, or my snack?
I give the stickiest hugs in Candy Land!
